part.text:
Updated `markup/goldmark/blockquotes/blockquotes.go` so GitHub alert labels match case-insensitively while retaining the captured type for normalization. Labels such as `[!note]`, `[!Note]`, and `[!nOtE]` now resolve as alerts.

Validated in the required container:

```sh
go test ./markup/goldmark/blockquotes
```

The focused package tests pass. `gofmt -d` produced no changes and `git diff --check` passed.
